description: This file contains Go source code implementing parsing logic for /proc/[pid]/mountstats, specifically for NFS mounts, including detailed statistics structures and parsing functions.

classes.name: Mount
classes.description: Represents a device mount point with optional detailed statistics.

classes.name: MountStats
classes.description: Interface for mount statistics, implemented by specific mount types.

classes.name: MountStatsNFS
classes.description: Holds detailed statistics for NFSv3 and v4 mounts, including byte, event, operation, and transport stats.

classes.name: NFSBytesStats
classes.description: Contains byte counters for NFS read/write operations.

classes.name: NFSEventsStats
classes.description: Contains event counters related to NFS operations.

classes.name: NFSOperationStats
classes.description: Holds statistics for individual NFS operations.

classes.name: NFSTransportStats
classes.description: Contains RPC transport statistics for NFS mounts.

methods.name: parseMountStats
methods.description: Parses a reader for mountstats data and returns a list of Mount objects with optional statistics.

methods.name: parseMount
methods.description: Parses a line describing a mount point into a Mount object.

methods.name: parseMountStatsNFS
methods.description: Parses NFS-specific mount statistics from a scanner.

methods.name: parseNFSBytesStats
methods.description: Parses byte counters from a string slice into NFSBytesStats.

methods.name: parseNFSOperationStats
methods.description: Parses per-operation NFS statistics until a blank line.

methods.name: parseNFSTransportStats
methods.description: Parses transport RPC statistics for NFS, handling different protocol versions.
